Wir . . Reichter ind . . Scheffene des ko-
ninclichs Stoelz van Aygen der Namen herna ge-
scr. stoin duin kunt alle Lüden mit dysen Brieue
ind kennen offenber dat vür vns komen ind yrsche-
nen is. Geirrart van Steinstroissen Bürger zu Ay-
gen du he in sinnen eirsten ganßen witzligen Stoel
sas mit sinen guden Vurrode ind Muitwillen in
der Zyt dat heit wael ind mit Reicht duin moicht
ind ouch nutz ind stede was du ind den heit deyde
so hait he verkoicht ind verkoift erflich ind ymmer-
me Heinrich van Ayrwilre ind johanne sinen Ge-
selle jn Vrber ind zo Nutz der . . Abdissen van
Porzyt ind des gemeinen Cloisters ind Conuent zo
Porzyt, sinen Hof gelegen zo Vetzauwen bynnen
deim Rich van Aygen mit eynindveirzich Morgen
Artlantz ind dry Morgen Beyntz gelegen in zwen
Stücken dy zo deim Houe gehoren, so wy deselue
Hof Huysinge Lantz ind Beynt, da lyt ind gele-
gen is in Grunde vur ind aten in Lenden in Breyden
in Nassen ind in Drüichidden mit alle sinen Reicht
ind Zobehoyr niet vßgescheiden jnd vmb eyn Sum-
me van Gelde dat is zo wessen ieclichen Morgen
Artlantz vmb zweyindzwenzich Marken zer Mosen
jnd yecklichen Morgen Beyntz ind de Huyffereide
mit der Huysinghe allit zer Mosen vmb vierind-
veirzich Marke dy de vürg. Heinrich ind johan,
alz van der . . Abdissen ind . . Conuentz wegen
vürscr. deim vürg. Geirraide van Steinstroissen ze-
moel wael bezailt hauen ind dar van vür vns ge-
nuich geschyt is, ind dar bouen vmb hundert Marke
eyschpeymentz alz van verseßenen Pait den dy . .
Abdysse ind . . Conuent vürß. deimseluen Geirrart
zemoel quyt ind los darzogelosen hauen ouer-
mitz alsulge Vurwerden, dat dat vürg. Guit allit
zemoel so weit vürscr. steit neit me in gilt noch
besweirt is, dan der vürg. . . Abdissen ind . .
Conuent eychtzien Sümmeren Roggen, deim He-
ligeist zo Aygen eyn Müdde Roggen, Fyen Bu-
ylgyns Wyue eyn Müdde Euen [?] ind seyß Schil-
linge ind zwein Capune, eynen Elter gelegen zo
Reichtergyn in der Kirche. also dat alle dis vürß.
Pait Zens ind Capune deim vürg. Geirrart af sal
goyn van der vürg. Summen Geltz, vortme so hait
deselue Geirrart sich vßgedoin Besitzunge ind Ge-
bruichunge, des vürg. Hoyfs mit alle sine Reigt
ind Zobehoyr, so wie he vürscr. steit, ind alle des
Reichtz Ainsproch of Vorderie des he dar ayn ye
gewan of noch hait op data dis Briefs ind hait
klaclos dar op verzegen ind verzyt mit Munde
ind mit dem Halme in Vrber ind zo Nutze der . .
Abdissen ind des gemeynen . . Conuentz zu Porzyt
vürscr. Vort me so hait ouch deselue Geirrart be-
kant ind in guden Truwen geloeft ind ouch mit
oem dar vür Bürgen gesat bescheiden Lüde mit
Namen Clois van Rosenberg sinen Bruder, ind
Willem Heinrichs Son syns Bruders, deit mit
oem bekant ind geloeft hauen alz gude gehoersam
Sachwalden ind Burgen ind yr yeclich vüral op
allit dat sie hauen ind gewennen moygen des vürg.
Hoyfs mit alle sinen Zobehoren jair ind Dach zo
weren ind alle reicht Ainsproch Krot ind Hindernis
afzeduin na Reicht ind Gewoinheit der Steyde van
Aygen in guden Truwen sunder eynicherkünne Ar-
gelist, Beheltenis der Leinheren yrs Reichtz alle dis
Guitz vürg. jnd dis zo Vrkunde der Wairheit so
hain wir. Reynart van Moercke . . Reichter. Cri-
stiain Lewe. Goyswyn van Punt. Arnout Wylde.
Mathys van Hoinkirchen. Sanders van Soerse.
Arnout van den Berghe. Merthyn Münt. Coinroit
van den Eychorne. jacob Colyn und johan Cho-
rus . . Scheffene des koninclichs Stoelz van Aygen
vürscr. ind vmb Beeden Wille der vürscr. Partien
op beyden Siden vns Sygille ain diesen Brief ge-
hangen. Gegeuen in deim jair vns heirren du man
schreif dusent dryhundert dar na in deim zweiind-
Seyßichsten jair des neisten Daghis na sinte Ka-
tharinen Dage der heiliger juncvrouw.
entries.english:
We, the judge and aldermen of the royal court of Aachen named below, make known to all people by this letter, and declare publicly, that Geirrart van Steinstroissen, citizen of Aachen, appeared before us. Being in his full and sound senses, with the good counsel and goodwill of his friends, at a time when he could do so well and rightfully, and as was useful and proper, he sold, for inheritance and in perpetuity, to Heinrich van Ayrwilre and Johann his companion, for the benefit of the abbess of Burtscheid and the whole cloister and convent of Burtscheid, his farm at Vetzauwen within the realm of Aachen, with 41 morgen of arable land and 3 morgen of meadow lying in two pieces that belong to the farm, just as the farm, house, land and meadow lie, in ground, above and below, in length, in breadth, in wetness and in [?] dryness, with all its rights and appurtenances, nothing excepted. The price was a sum of money, namely 22 marks per morgen of arable land, and per morgen of meadow and the farmstead with the house, in total, 44 marks. Heinrich and Johann paid this in full to Geirrart van Steinstroissen on behalf of the abbess and convent, and he was satisfied before us. Beyond this, the abbess and convent released Geirrart entirely from 100 marks of arrears of payment, on condition that the property is encumbered and burdened with nothing more than: to the abbess and convent 18 sümmeren of rye, to the Holy Spirit at Aachen one müdde of rye, to the wife of Fyen Buylgyn one müdde [?] and six shillings and two capons, and to an altar in the church at Reichtergyn [?]. All these payments of rent and capons are to be deducted from the stated sum.

Furthermore, Geirrart gave up possession and use of the farm with all its rights and appurtenances, as stated above, and all claim and demand that he ever acquired or now has in it as of the date of this letter. He renounced and gave it up without complaint, with mouth and with the straw, for the benefit of the abbess and the whole convent of Burtscheid. Moreover, Geirrart declared and promised in good faith, and also appointed as sureties discreet men, namely Nicolaus von Rosenberg, his brother, and Willem, son of Heinrich, his brother. They declared and promised, as good obedient trustees and sureties, each of them jointly, to warrant the farm with all its appurtenances for a year and a day, and to remove all claims, [?] and hindrance according to the law and custom of the city of Aachen, in good faith and without any deceit, reserving the rights of the lords of the fief in all this property.

In witness of the truth, we, Reynart van Moercke, judge, Cristiain Lewe, Goyswyn van Punt, Arnout Wylde, Mathys van Hoinkirchen, Sanders van Soerse, Arnout van den Berghe, Merthyn Münt, Coinroit van den Eychorne, Jacob Colyn and Johan Chorus, aldermen of the royal court of Aachen, have hung our seals on this letter at the request of both parties. Given in the year when one wrote one thousand three hundred and sixty-two, on the day after St. Katharine's day, the holy virgin.

facts.content: sold his farm at Vetzauwen within the realm of Aachen to Heinrich van Ayrwilre and Johann for the benefit of the abbess and convent of Burtscheid.
stood surety for his brother Geirrart van Steinstroissen to warrant the farm at Vetzauwen sold to the abbess and convent of Burtscheid for a year and a day.
stood surety for Geirrart van Steinstroissen, his father's brother, to warrant the farm at Vetzauwen sold to the abbess and convent of Burtscheid for a year and a day.
